title: Beautiful stockings.
text: Beautiful stockings.. I wasnt sure about the material. I was hoping it wasnt the cheap felt . These are gorgous! They are a nice thick patterned velvet . They are a nice and bright red color. Made very well with a quality material. Feel almost silky when you run your hand on it.
